title: Rho header
description: A full-width 72px bar stuck to the top: a large wordmark, four plain nav links beside it, and on the right two text links and a mint button. On phones the wordmark and a menu icon open a simple dropdown list. Its colours follow the page's tone.
notes: tone="dark" by default (sits over the dark hero); inside rho-tone-flow it follows the page
the phone menu is a native <details> dropdown: no JavaScript
